title: datamix mixture
description: Sources, weights and quality gates for one corpus build.

output.description: Where the corpus goes and how big it is.

kind.description: sft = JSONL for src/sft.rs; text = <|endoftext|>-separated for ChunkedWordDataSet; none = report only.

path.description: Output file. The eval holdout is written next to it as <path>.eval.

report.description: Markdown build report. Empty = printed only.

seed.description: Seeds every shuffle and draw; the same mixture always builds the same corpus.

weight_by.description: What a source weight is a share of, and what the budget counts. records mixes by how many examples each source contributes, whatever their length.

records.description: Record budget, used instead of tokens when weight_by = records. 0 = as large as the weights allow.

tokens.description: Token budget. 0 = as large as the weights allow without any source exceeding its epochs.

shard_bytes.description: Split the output into files of at most this size, at document borders. 0 = one file.

filter.description: Quality defaults, inherited by every source.

llm.description: Local OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio and friends). Only used by kind = "llm" sources and judge filters.

model.description: Model id as the server reports it. Empty = whatever it has loaded.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait on one completion.

cache.description: Directory of cached replies. Empty disables caching.

completion_template.description: Chat template written out, which switches every call to /v1/completions. {system} and {user} are substituted. Prefilling an empty <think></think> here turns a reasoning model's deliberation off. Empty uses /v1/chat/completions.

completion_stop.description: Where a completion ends - the template's turn terminator, e.g. <|im_end|>.

workers.description: Requests in flight. Match the server's parallel slot count (LM Studio's PARALLEL).

cache_only.description: Answer only out of the cache and never open a socket; a miss drops the record. Use it to assemble a corpus from a long rewrite that is still running.

max_tokens.description: One UTF-8 byte is one token (the tokenizer is byte-level).

min_alpha_ratio.description: Minimum share of letters/digits — kills base64 blobs and binary dumps.

max_dup_line_ratio.description: Maximum share of lines repeating an earlier line.

max_line_bytes.description: Longest single line — kills minified files.

must_contain.description: Keep only documents matching one of these (case-insensitive).

must_not_contain.description: Drop documents matching any of these.

dedup.description: near = MinHash over word 5-grams. On short formulaic records prefer exact.

languages.description: ISO codes kept from a parquet language column. Empty = no filtering.

judge.description: Prompt sent to the local model with each record; kept only if the reply starts with judge_expect.

judge_expect.description: Word the judge's reply must start with (default "yes").

judge_model.description: Model for the judge alone. Empty inherits [llm] model.

judge_temperature.description: Temperature for the judge alone (default 0). Judging is a classification, not a generation.

trim_turns.description: chat records: trim to the last whole exchange that fits max_tokens instead of dropping the conversation.

max_words.description: Cap on the words of one record, counted with the model's own splitter (wordseg). This is the unit the backbone unrolls in — match it to SFT_MAX_WORDS / WORDS_PER_SEQ.

transform.description: Rewrite every record through the local model before it is filtered: this is the system prompt, the record goes up as {"messages":[...]} and the reply must come back in the same shape. Cached on the record's own text, so a corpus rewritten once stays rewritten across every later build.

transform_when.description: Only rewrite records whose text contains one of these. Empty rewrites all of them.

transform_only.description: Keep ONLY the records the rewrite applied to, dropping everything transform_when did not match. With cache_only this materializes a rewrite into a corpus of its own, which other mixtures read as a plain jsonl source.

transform_model.description: Model for the rewrite alone. Empty inherits the [llm] model.

transform_temperature.description: Temperature for the rewrite alone (default 0.2 - a translation, not a generation).

verify.description: Compile the code a rewritten record carries and drop what does not build. "rust" extracts its ```rust blocks and runs rustc; empty disables the check.

verify_repair.description: Prompt for one repair pass: the record and rustc's own errors go up, the corrected record comes back. Empty drops a failing record instead of trying to fix it.

system_strip.description: Sentences cut out of a system turn before anything else. The corpus's system turns are a handful of repeated strings; an identity line the model never sees at inference is a prop it learns to lean on.

system_fold.description: After stripping, move what remains of the system turn to the front of the first user turn and drop the system turn. Deleting the turn outright is unsafe: often the remainder is the record's only instruction.

kind.description: file/dir = text on disk; parquet = a text column; chat = parquet whose messages column is a list<struct<role, content>>; dolly/jsonl = JSONL records; synth = template expansion; llm = generated by the local model.

path.description: Input path. Required for every kind except llm.

weight.description: Share of the output tokens, relative to the other weights.

epochs.description: How often this source may repeat to reach its share.

ext.description: dir only: extensions to read, without the dot. Empty = every file.

separator.description: file/dir: document separator (default <|endoftext|>). Empty = the whole file is one document.

text_column.description: parquet: text column; jsonl: the field to read.

language_column.description: parquet: the language column used by `languages`.

count.description: synth: examples to draw (0 = every combination). llm: examples to generate.

category.description: Category tag for records that carry none (default: the source name).

prompt.description: llm: user prompt. {seed} = a rendered seed_file instruction, {n} = the batch size.

batch.description: llm: examples asked for per call.

seed_file.description: llm: .syn file whose rendered instructions seed {seed}.

temperature.description: llm: per-source override of [llm] temperature. Negative = inherit.

skip_files.description: dir/parquet over a directory: skip this many files of the sorted listing (resume a corpus you already trained on).

max_files.description: dir/parquet over a directory: read at most this many files after the skip. 0 = all.

role_column.description: chat: the role leaf of the messages column (name or dotted path). Default "role".

content_column.description: chat: the content leaf of the messages column. Default "content".

select_column.description: chat: a flat column naming each row's subset (SmolTalk's "source"). Requires select_values.

select_values.description: chat: keep only rows whose select_column holds one of these. Requires select_column.

seeds.description: llm: how many seed examples to render into {seed} per call (default 3). They are rendered in the exact output format, so they pin the syntax as well as the subject.

judge_model.description: Model for the judge alone. Empty inherits [llm] model.

judge_temperature.description: Temperature for the judge alone (default 0). Judging is a classification, not a generation.

trim_turns.description: chat records: trim to the last whole exchange that fits max_tokens instead of dropping the conversation.

max_words.description: Cap on the words of one record, counted with the model's own splitter (wordseg). This is the unit the backbone unrolls in — match it to SFT_MAX_WORDS / WORDS_PER_SEQ.
